pages.title: Epigraph
pages.text: $(italic)Deep in the shady sadness of a vale$(br)Far sunken from the healthy breath of morn,$(br)Far from the fiery noon, and eve's one star,$(br)Sat gray-hair'd Saturn, quiet as a stone,$()$(br2)John Keats, $(italic)Hyperion$()
